threat_event: Ransomware encrypts staff endpoints, file services, the integration platform, and the data warehouse, halting aid processing, refunds, and campus operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Campus 3 flat network; standing SaaS administrator privileges; no IT DR plan; recovery of college-managed workloads never tested
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08; SYS-10; SYS-11; BP-01 to BP-06
sp800_53_controls: CP-9; CP-10; CP-4; AC-6; SC-7; SI-4
existing_controls: MFA for staff; EDR with 24x7 MSSP; isolated write-once backups in a second region; SaaS vendors' own recovery
treatment_plan: IT DR plan; quarterly restore tests starting with the integration platform; segment Campus 3; privileged access management for SaaS administrators; executive ransomware tabletop

threat_event: Exfiltration of student and aid records for extortion before or during a ransomware attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No egress alerting on the data warehouse or file services; SIS, FAMS, and LMS logs not in the SIEM; 46 analysts can export student-level data
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08 data warehouse and file services; SYS-01; SYS-03
existing_controls: EDR; SIEM on identity, email, firewall, cloud, and EDR logs; MFA for staff
treatment_plan: SIS, FAMS, and LMS logs to the SIEM; egress alerting on large transfers; role-based warehouse views
exposure_estimate_usd: $2.5M-$6M (up to 41,000 consumers in 41 states; counsel, forensics, credit monitoring, regulators)

threat_event: Malware spreads from a Campus 3 lab or staff device to campus safety devices and staff systems on the flat network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Campus 3 has no internal segmentation; cybersecurity lab not isolated
existing_controls: EDR on staff devices; antivirus on lab computers; campus firewall at the internet edge
treatment_plan: VLANs and deny-by-default rules at Campus 3 matching Campuses 1 and 2; isolate the cybersecurity lab

threat_event: Emergency notification is delayed because the console can be reached only through SSO (identity provider outage or forced credential reset during an incident)
threat_source: Identity provider outage or attacker lockout
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No break-glass account or secondary sign-in for the emergency notification console
existing_controls: Manual alternates (public address, radio, officers); annual notification test
treatment_plan: Break-glass account and vendor-hosted secondary sign-in; weekly contact list export; include an identity outage in the 2027 annual test
exposure_estimate_usd: Not primarily financial (student and staff safety; Clery findings)

threat_event: Student portal account takeover with reused passwords; refund bank details changed and credit balance refunds diverted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Student MFA optional (54% enrolled); no re-authentication or out-of-band check for refund bank changes; no detection of bank-change patterns
existing_controls: Smart lockout; manual call-back after students report missing refunds
treatment_plan: Step-up MFA and a confirmation message to the prior contact for bank changes (2026-11-30); 3-day hold on refunds after a bank change; MFA by default for students (2027-03-31); SIEM rule for bank-change bursts
exposure_estimate_usd: $60K-$300K a year (diverted refunds repaid by the college; 23 cases in 2025-26)

threat_event: Fraudulent online applicants (synthetic or stolen identities) enroll and receive Title IV funds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual, inconsistent identity checks; no document or liveness verification; no OIG referral procedure
existing_controls: Admissions staff review IDs for online applicants; financial aid verification for selected students
treatment_plan: Document and liveness verification for online applicants (January 2027 start); fraud indicators in the CRM; written OIG referral procedure (P08 runbook 2)
exposure_estimate_usd: $50K-$500K a year (Title IV liabilities, repayments, staff time)

threat_event: Former adjuncts, preceptors, or contractors use stale local LMS accounts to view or change grades and student work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 140 local LMS accounts outside the identity provider; 19 inactive over 180 days; no review
existing_controls: Faculty accounts in the identity provider; LMS audit trail
treatment_plan: Move preceptors and guests to identity provider guest accounts with expiry; disable the 19 inactive accounts; semiannual review

threat_event: Compromise of a third-party servicer account (no MFA) exposes ISIR and aid data in the FAMS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The servicer's 8 local FAMS accounts use passwords only; contract has no MFA or incident notice terms
existing_controls: Servicer contract with confidentiality terms; FAMS role limits
treatment_plan: Contract amendment requiring federation with MFA, 72-hour incident notice, and annual assurance; disable local sign-in

threat_event: Takeover of a SaaS administrator account (identity provider, SIS, LMS, or FAMS) with standing privileges
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 IT staff administer SaaS with everyday accounts; push MFA, not phishing-resistant; annual review
existing_controls: MFA with number matching; conditional access
treatment_plan: Separate administrator accounts; FIDO2 keys for administrators; privileged access management for SaaS; quarterly review

threat_event: A vendor without FERPA school-official or security terms misuses or loses student data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 22 of about 90 student-data vendors lack those terms; no periodic review
treatment_plan: Amend or replace the 22 contracts; purchasing gate; vendor tiering (P09)

threat_event: FAFSA-derived (ISIR) data used beyond HEA purposes in the data warehouse, the AI-002 model, and enrollment marketing analytics
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ISIR fields copied nightly into the data warehouse without a use review
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08 data warehouse; AI-002; BP-10; BP-15
regulatory_driver: HEA sec. 483 (FSA Handbook Vol. 2 Ch. 7); N61-R02 (314.4(c)(2))
treatment_plan: Remove ISIR-derived fields and purge history; data use review before new warehouse fields; retrain analysts
exposure_estimate_usd: Title IV program review finding; limited direct cost

threat_event: Aid spreadsheets emailed without encryption to the servicer are intercepted or misdirected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Financial aid staff email ISIR and award spreadsheets (7 of 20 sampled unencrypted)
existing_controls: TLS between mail providers when supported
treatment_plan: Restricted FAMS report role for the servicer; enforced message encryption rule for aid data

threat_event: Extended SIS vendor outage beyond the BIA MTD for registration and records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor RTO 24 h and RPO 4 h versus BIA RTO 8 h and RPO 1 h; no local read-only extract
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 with tested DR; printed rosters
treatment_plan: Nightly read-only roster and enrollment extract; recovery terms at the 2027 renewal

threat_event: The integration platform cannot be restored within its 24-hour RTO after an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Never restore-tested; no runbook; stale service secrets
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08 integration platform; BP-01; BP-04; BP-05; BP-06
treatment_plan: Restore test 2026-10-27, then quarterly; rebuild runbook

threat_event: Data warehouse restore fails, delaying institutional reporting and early alert
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Never restore-tested
existing_controls: Daily backups; rebuild from SIS extracts possible
treatment_plan: Restore test in the quarterly program

threat_event: The employer partner portal is not restored within the 24-hour contract commitment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Never restore-tested; contractor-built
treatment_plan: Restore and failover test 2027-01; runbook from the contractor

threat_event: Recovery is uncoordinated and slow because there is no IT disaster recovery plan
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No IT DR plan; no recovery roles or training
treatment_plan: IT DR plan from the BIA by 2026-12-31; recovery role training by 2027-02-28
exposure_estimate_usd: Adds 1-3 days to any major outage

threat_event: Title IV credit balance refunds miss the 14-day deadline after a term-start outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Up to 1,800 refunds due in a term-start week; no documented paper-check procedure
existing_controls: Bank file can be re-sent; staff know the manual process informally
treatment_plan: Documented emergency refund procedure from the last reconciled refund file; tested in the 2026-11-10 tabletop
exposure_estimate_usd: Title IV finding; emergency student grants $20K-$100K

threat_event: Insider browsing or misuse of student records in the SIS or FAMS goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review of SIS or FAMS user activity; logs not in the SIEM
treatment_plan: SIS and FAMS logs to the SIEM; monthly activity review for high-risk transactions (exports, bank changes, grade changes)

threat_event: Admissions staff and all advisors see full student records, including aid holds, without a legitimate educational interest
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad SIS roles; no field-level restrictions
treatment_plan: Role redesign: advisors see assigned students only; admissions loses access after enrollment

threat_event: A student uses the shared lab local administrator password to compromise lab machines and pivot to other systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 410 lab computers at Campuses 2 and 3 share one local administrator password
existing_controls: Lab VLAN at Campus 2; reimage at reboot
treatment_plan: Local administrator password solution on all lab computers; isolate the Campus 3 lab

threat_event: Unsupported firmware on door controllers or video recorders is exploited to unlock doors or disable cameras
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 64 door controllers and 11 video recorders on unsupported firmware; on the staff network at Campus 3
treatment_plan: Replace controllers and recorders (2027 capital plan); campus safety VLAN at Campus 3 first

threat_event: Phishing leads to a staff mailbox compromise and payroll or vendor payment fraud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9.4% phishing click rate; payment changes verified by email
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for payment changes; targeted training for finance and HR

threat_event: An unreviewed integration change or a stale service account secret corrupts or exposes student data (for example, a wrong refund file)
threat_source: Staff error or attacker using old secrets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change tickets or second reviewer; 6 service passwords unrotated since 2023
treatment_plan: Change procedure with a second reviewer; vaulted secrets with rotation

threat_event: Exploitation of an unpatched internet-facing or cloud system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12 of 40 sampled critical findings remediated late; lab and campus safety networks not scanned
existing_controls: Quarterly authenticated scans; monthly external scans
treatment_plan: Monthly scans; known-exploited vulnerability tracking; scan lab and campus safety VLANs

threat_event: Exploitable weaknesses in the student portal and internal network stay undiscovered because the penetration test is narrow
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 test covered only internet-facing hosts; scope not risk-based
treatment_plan: Risk-based scope for the 2026 test including portal workflows, the partner portal, and internal networks

threat_event: Customer information kept indefinitely enlarges the impact of any breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention and disposal schedule; aid records kept since 2009
treatment_plan: Retention schedule meeting 34 CFR 668.24 and 314.4(c)(6); annual disposal

threat_event: Copier drives returned at lease end expose scanned student documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No sanitization certificate for 4 of 4 lease returns
treatment_plan: Sanitization certificate required in lease contracts

threat_event: FTC, FSA, OIG, or state notices are late or missed after a breach or fraud event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No notification procedure before P08; students in 41 states
treatment_plan: P08 notification matrix and runbooks (approved 2026-09-17); decision log; tabletop

threat_event: Slow or confused decisions in a major incident because the plan has never been exercised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Last tabletop in 2024; new runbooks untested
treatment_plan: Executive ransomware tabletop 2026-11-10; fraud tabletop 2027-01-20

threat_event: AI-001 applicant scoring steers admissions attention away from groups of applicants through proxies for protected characteristics
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor model used since 2025-09 without bias testing or documentation; ZIP code and device type among inputs
existing_controls: Admissions representatives may call any inquiry
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: bias testing, remove proxy inputs, minimum contact rule for every inquiry

threat_event: AI-002 early-alert model relies on ISIR-derived inputs and flags some groups of students more often than others
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Built in-house without a data use or fairness review
treatment_plan: Remove ISIR inputs (with R-011); fairness testing each term; student notice

threat_event: AI-003 assistant discloses a student's records to the wrong person or gives wrong financial aid information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bought on a card without FERPA or security terms; signed-in mode reads SIS data; no output testing
treatment_plan: Contract with FERPA and security terms; restrict SIS data to the signed-in student; answer testing; disclosure banner

threat_event: The AI-004 tutor vendor uses student prompts and work to train its models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Department purchase without FERPA terms
treatment_plan: Contract with no-training and deletion terms before the pilot continues

threat_event: AI-005 proctoring flags fall disproportionately on students with disabilities or darker skin tones, leading to unfair misconduct referrals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review of flag rates by group; flags sometimes forwarded without faculty review
treatment_plan: Faculty review of every flag before any action; accommodation path; flag-rate monitoring

threat_event: Department-bought SaaS tools hold student data without security or FERPA review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 SaaS tools bought on cards; no purchasing gate
treatment_plan: Purchasing gate; card spend review for SaaS; register reconciliation quarterly

threat_event: Compromise of the MSSP or the SIS vendor is used as a supply-chain entry point
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSSP has privileged EDR agents; SIS vendor holds all records; SOC 2 reviewed only at onboarding before 2026
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 and CUEC review (P09); MSSP actions through the broker; incident terms

threat_event: The access control vendor's always-on remote tool at Campus 3 is used for intrusion (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unmanaged vendor remote tool on the flat Campus 3 network
treatment_plan: Remove the tool; vendor sessions through the broker

threat_event: Employer partner portal accounts with passwords only are compromised, exposing sponsored students' consented data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password-only sign-in for partner users
treatment_plan: MFA for partner users

threat_event: Cloud servers drift from secure settings because there is no configuration standard
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No benchmark baselines; 3 of 10 sampled servers failed more than 20% of checks
treatment_plan: STD-01 configuration standard; monthly drift report

threat_event: Transferred staff keep prior SIS roles
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Prior roles not removed on transfer (6 of 25 sampled)
treatment_plan: Automated prior-role removal on transfer

threat_event: Adjunct faculty keep access between terms because contracts end without a termination record
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 of 25 sampled departures active more than 30 days
existing_controls: Identity provider disables on ERP termination
treatment_plan: Contract end date drives access expiry in the identity provider

threat_event: Denial-of-service attack on the student portal or LMS during an exam week
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dependence on SaaS availability
treatment_plan: Accepted by the CIO: vendor protections are adequate; exam rescheduling procedure covers short outages

threat_event: Internet outage at Campus 2 or 3 (single carrier)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One carrier each at Campuses 2 and 3
existing_controls: Staff can work remotely; SaaS reachable from home
treatment_plan: Accepted by the CIO: classes continue; cost of a second carrier exceeds expected loss

threat_event: A hurricane disrupts the Florida campuses and staff for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All 3 campuses and central administration in Florida
existing_controls: SaaS systems hosted outside Florida; remote work
treatment_plan: Hurricane section in the IT DR plan; remote operations for financial aid and student accounts

threat_event: Financial aid, student accounts, or service desk staff mishandle a security event or fraud attempt for lack of role-based training
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No role-based security training outside the security team
treatment_plan: Role-based modules for aid, student accounts, service desk, and administrators

threat_event: A lost or stolen staff laptop with cached student data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mobile staff; cached reports
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption on all staff endpoints; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted by the CIO: encryption makes a reportable event unlikely

threat_event: Staff send education records to the wrong recipient
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual email handling
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Chief Compliance Officer: low volume and impact; logged as disclosures when they happen

threat_event: FERPA disclosure records are incomplete for data sent to vendors through integrations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure records kept only for transcript requests
treatment_plan: Integration register records the school-official basis for each feed

threat_event: Interfaces without written interconnection terms leak student contact data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 of 37 interfaces lack terms
treatment_plan: Interconnection terms for the 6 interfaces

threat_event: The hosted payment page or payment plan vendor is compromised and card data is skimmed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Card handling outsourced to vendors
existing_controls: Vendor-hosted page; vendors attest to PCI DSS
treatment_plan: Vendors hold PCI DSS responsibility by contract; annual attestation review

threat_event: New state AI and privacy laws (for example Colorado SB26-189 from 2027-01-01) reach admissions scoring of out-of-state online applicants before the college is ready
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Online applicants from 41 states; AI-001 materially influences who is contacted
treatment_plan: Counsel review of SB26-189 scope (including its FERPA provisions) and other states; notices and human review built into P10 conditions
